channel.title: Microsoft SOC Brief · Power Platform
channel.description: Power Platform only: brief items due within 7 days and new ones, Message Center, campaigns, security baselines, Learn changes, blogs, community articles, Threat Research, MSRC CVEs, KQL queries, Graph API Radar, Graph API and role changes, M365 endpoints, first-party apps, component versions - last 7 days

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Power Platform admin center stops exporting inventory data to Azure Data Lake on 1 Dec 2026; move to the Power Platform inventory API
item.description:
Any governance or shadow-app report fed by the inventory export (apps, flows, agents) stops updating silently on 1 Dec.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-12-01 · Find reports and Sentinel/Log Analytics ingestion that read the inventory export and switch them to the inventory API before 1 Dec 2026.

item.title: [Due in 4 days] Copilot in the Power Automate designer for cloud flows and agent flows ends support on 30 November 2026
item.description:
Makers will move natural-language flow building to external AI assistants and MCP connections, which are outside the Power Automate designer's own controls.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-11-30 · Tell Power Automate makers; review whether the Power Automate plugin for GitHub Copilot or the Copilot Studio MCP route is allowed in your tenant.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] AI-generated descriptions for Power Apps model-driven apps end support on 30 November 2026
item.description:
Low SOC weight: a maker convenience is removed; it is listed because Message Center files it as a retirement.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-11-30 · No action stated by Microsoft.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 6 days] Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Power Apps prompts move automatically from Anthropic, Grok and older GPT models to newer GPT models on 2 December 2026
item.description:
Flows that parse model output (for example to route or auto-close tickets) can break silently when the model behind a prompt changes, and the subprocessor behind those prompts changes for tenants that had chosen Anthropic or Grok.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-12-02 · List prompts on the retiring models, test the flows and agents that parse their output against the replacement models, and update the AI subprocessor record before 2 December 2026.

Open in the Microsoft SOC Brief · Microsoft source

item.title: [Due in 4 days] App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com retire on 30 November 2026; new app creation stops mid-October
item.description:
Apps built by makers in these two experiences hold data connections; migrating them into Copilot Studio or Copilot Cowork changes where they run and who owns them, and an app that is not migrated silently stops being reachable.

Power Platform · deadline 2026-11-30 · Identify makers using App Builder or vibe.powerapps.com, tell them about the 30 November date, and review the migrated apps' connections and sharing in Copilot Studio as they move.
